title: WeShop to Present at A.G.P.’s Virtual Consumer Showcase on November 11-12, 2026
summary: The post WeShop to Present at A.G.P.’s Virtual Consumer Showcase on November 11-12, 2026 appeared first on WeShop .
body_markdown:
NEW YORK, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — WeShop Holdings Limited (“WeShop” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: WSHP), the community-owned shopping app on a mission to make shopping more rewarding, today announced that Maria Weaver, WeShop’s Chief Executive Officer and Director, will present at the A.G.P. Virtual Consumer Showcase, to be held on November 11-12, 2026.


## Presentation Details


- **Date:** Thursday, November 12, 2026
- **Time:** 10:30 a.m. ET
- Register for the webcast here.


Ms. Weaver will deliver a corporate presentation outlining WeShop’s business model and how it turns everyday shopping into customer ownership. The presentation will review U.K. pilot learnings, the roadmap for the U.S. launch, and how WeShop plans to scale commerce, advertising, and retail media revenue to drive long-term shareholder value.


The Company will host 1×1 meetings throughout the conference. For more information or to schedule a meeting, please contact your A.G.P. representative or email WeShop@KCSA.com.


## About WeShop


WeShop Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: WSHP) is a community-owned shopping platform that turns everyday purchases into ownership. Through its proprietary ShareBack™ program, members earn shares in WeShop when they shop and refer others to the platform, giving the people who help grow the company the opportunity to own a piece of it. With access to hundreds of leading retailers and more than a billion products, WeShop brings shopping, rewards, and ownership together in one experience. By putting consumers at the center, WeShop is building a community where members are more than shoppers; they are shareholders.
